title: Web Browsers on Video Game Consoles
summary: A historical exploration of web browsers that shipped on or were available for video game consoles across different generations, from early attempts to modern implementations.
problem_solved: Documents and analyzes the forgotten or overlooked history of web browsing capabilities on gaming platforms, a niche but fascinating intersection of gaming and web technology.
why_valuable: Provides unique historical context about how browsers were integrated (or struggled to be integrated) into gaming consoles, offering insights for developers and tech enthusiasts interested in cross-platform web experiences.
